sources.checked: The reported UCF Yes/No 72.20 to 85.32 is a mean across tested models, not an InternVL2-8B/IPAD guarantee. Same-forward probability scoring motivates this experiment.

Table lists IPAD at 25 FPS, which does not verify these local extracted frame files. VERA frame AUROC 0.490 is reported for IPAD; differing scenes/splits prevent numerical equivalence. The paper does not justify declaring normal references mandatory for all VLM methods.
